subject.title: feat(ui): animated Clawd mascot on the new-session welcome hero

question: Should this initial welcome-hero change land the complete nine-mood reusable mascot system, or should it be narrowed to the idle behavior currently consumed?
rationale: Current main already animates the welcome hero with a bounded CSS implementation, while the branch adds a much larger future-facing component API and an independently maintained port of the native mascot; code review cannot decide that permanent scope and ownership tradeoff.

options.title: Approve the full mascot surface
options.body: Land all nine moods now and explicitly own the Swift and web implementations as synchronized product surfaces.

options.title: Narrow the initial integration
options.body: Keep the component architecture but ship only the pose and animation behavior required by the welcome hero, adding other moods with their consumers.

options.title: Retain the current CSS mascot
options.body: Close this PR if native parity and reusable web moods are not currently worth the additional runtime and maintenance surface.

recommendation.title: Narrow the initial integration
recommendation.body: Keep the component architecture but ship only the pose and animation behavior required by the welcome hero, adding other moods with their consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence connects this person most directly to current Control UI and mascot product direction.
